title: WordRAM verdict condition
statement: For a word width $W$, program $code$, Boolean value $dec$, integer $r$, initial memory $m$, and configuration $cfg$, the execution of $code$ from $cfg$ must terminate with the verdict determined by $dec$ and $r$. The configuration’s result register must contain the $W$-bit encoding of $r$, and its memory must agree with $m$ outside the result and decision registers.
